The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of simulation and rendering can be a powerful tool to learn and control systems that are difficult to model in a purely differentiable fashion.
differentiable physics simulation can serve as a general-purpose system identification tool for a wide range of physical systems, without the need for explicit 3D supervision.
